description: This script handles platform-specific upgrade procedures for the Tegra target in an OpenWrt build system. It includes functions to check image integrity, copy configuration files, and perform upgrade steps, such as writing images, partition handling, and bootloader updates.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Verifies if the image's partition layout matches the device, extracts the boot sector, and compares layout differences to determine whether a full image write is necessary.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Mounts the target partition and copies upgrade backup configuration files to it.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the main upgrade process, including partition comparison, image writing, and bootloader update based on the provided image.
